title: The Project Review Room
prompt: Use Dazzler to design the project review room for its fictional reader task. A vertical milestone spine accompanies a document review sheet; document tabs sit across the sheet and the review action closes the evidence. Retain the existing data and functional controls, with keyboard and mobile access. Use Poppins, #3A5A13 and #E1F1C8. Preserve factual caveats and local-only behavior; do not imply real booking, payment, publication or account changes.
